description: This file defines the Operator class within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters operators namespace. It provides methods for handling filter operator tags, validating operators, and converting operands for SQL queries.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents a filter operator used in JSON API filtering, with methods for validation, transformation, and SQL operand handling.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts an operator string into its filter tag representation.

methods.name: stripFilterTag
methods.description: Removes the filter tag wrapper from an operator string to extract the operator.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a valid operator based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Checks if the provided operator matches the operator represented by this class.

methods.name: hasOperator
methods.description: Determines if a filter string contains an operator.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands expected by this operator, default is 1.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Converts an array of operands into a SQL-compatible string, quoting and quoting numeric values appropriately.
